user_instruction: review分支里面有很多来自mathvision的样本。你帮我进行一阶段审核，把图像过于复杂（比如十条线各种交点）、答案不符、不需要视觉也能回答的样本先删去。

criteria.visual_complexity: 密集交叉、叠线、纹理或多层图形造成明显辨识负担；不按单纯网格线数量自动排除。
criteria.answer_mismatch: 依据题干和实际图像可独立证实答案不符；尚不能验证不等于错误。
criteria.no_visual_needed: 仅完整题干和文字选项就足以确定答案；若仍需图像对应选项字母则保留。

method: 逐题读取题干、答案及已有证据，查看全部原图/重绘图配对缩略图，对疑点放大检查；删除项由主审复核。
limits: 一阶段筛选并非全部数学答案的完整独立证明。保留题仍待用户审核，未产生任何Pass或正式批准。

Every move she makes never moves further from Z, and she has equal probability to go down every valid move. What is the expected number of moves she can make?\n<image1>

records.question: Sujay and Rishabh are taking turns marking lattice points within a square board in the Cartesian plane with opposite vertices $(1, 1)$,$(n, n)$ for some constant $n$. Sujay loses when the two-point pattern $P$ below shows up. That is, Sujay loses when there exists a pair of points $(x, y)$ and $(x + 2, y + 1)$. He and Rishabh stop marking points when the pattern $P$ appears on the board. If Rishabh goes first, let $S$ be the set of all integers $3 \le n \le 100$ such that Rishabh has a strategy to always trick Sujay into being the one who creates $P$. Find the sum of all elements of $S$.\n<image1>

records.question: Will stands at a point $P$ on the edge of a circular room with perfectly reflective walls. He shines two laser pointers into the room, forming angles of $n^o$ and $(n + 1)^o$ with the tangent at $P$, where $n$ is a positive integer less than $90$. (The balloon remains at the same position $H$ above $O$ as described above.)  Determine the greatest length of rope that can be saved.
